title: Thalorix AI engine — RunPod worker request/response contract
derivedFrom: serverless_handler.py handler/retrieval functions and orchestrator planning/storage/cache source; reviewed on 2026-10-16
status: Derived from source code. Not captured from a live endpoint; no endpoint ID, key or private log is included, and no paid endpoint was called.
scope: This endpoint is the outer boundary of Abdelrahman Hesham's AI component in the Thalorix university graduation project.
workerStartup: At module start-up the worker prepares cache/volume paths and loads the models (load_all_models) before registering handler(event) with runpod.serverless.start. A cold worker therefore loads models before it answers any job.

session_id.constraint: single directory identifier, at most128 characters; traversal/path separators are rejected

attachments.note: base64 content; text and PDF text are processed. No vision model is wired by default, so images fall back to a metadata note.

session_context.note: replayed into a fresh worker session for continuity

retrieval_action.note: file/preview retrieval from the project volume. Inside handler(event) this branch runs before the model-ready check and reads stored artifacts without running inference; it does not make worker start-up model-free.

flow: retrieval_action requests are dispatched first and return stored files or a preview (no inference)
Other requests are rejected with ok:false if the models are not ready
Restore or create the session; replay session_context if the worker is fresh
InputProcessor turns text and attachments into a UserIntent
handle_chat_message routes to chat, edit/debug or build using the conversation, architect, coder and repair roles
Build requests run the tiered generation pipeline synchronously inside the job and persist the project to the volume

result.reply_type: build_completed for builds, edit_completed / edit_failed for edits, other values for chat replies
result.retrieval: paths to fetch files or a preview

response.errorDiagnostics: Tracebacks are absent/null by default and remain in worker logs. EXPOSE_ERROR_TRACEBACKS=1 explicitly enables debugging excerpts; no deployed environment was inspected or changed.

sourceModelDefaults.coder: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct in this handler; Coder-14B in model_registry.py and model_loader.py
sourceModelDefaults.note: Defaults only. ARCHITECT_MODEL, CODER_MODEL and CONVERSATION_MODEL environment settings can override them; the deployed configuration was not inspected.

localSourceChecks.scope: Focused local source hardening, not deployed or certified as a secure execution sandbox.
changes: request identifiers and generated planning names are checked before directory use
retrieved file paths are checked against the project directory
volume storage paths reject directory redirection
cached results are reused only for an existing project in the current session workdir
